decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting system fits the firm's specialist, certification-driven marine and industrial strengths, so despite its niche scale it is more likely to be retained than cut.
As a flagship-style pendant luminaire that matches the firm's stated push toward efficient, application-focused interior lighting, it would be unusual to withdraw it this soon.

The marine HMI searchlight serves a known niche, but its older HMI technology is increasingly out of step with the firm's LED- and sustainability-led direction and the company has already shown willingness to prune adjacent searchlight lines.
